build.title: Settings interface as an asset type (settings-ui@1)

said.text: make the settings interface an asset type so several apps use the same settings interface with the same options. New optional asset type `settings`: layout tabs-top / tabs-side / list, header, search, descriptions, tab order + labels, hide (tab/group/panel/setting ids), data-only option groups the app gets while the asset is active. Engine core/engines/settingsui.ts, fixture settings-ui.json, web settings library reads it, starters standard (default) / side-tabs / developer-apps. Android twin deferred.

steps.text: Settings library reads the asset (layout, header, search, hide, groups)
Starters, app manifests, re-bakes, fixture + checker, CI, docs
